source_of_truth: Operator directive 2026-06-10, REDUCED at D012 (2026-06-11 split): develop the worktree-isolation SUBSTRATE — per-plan git worktrees created from a recorded base SHA with rollback atomicity and recorded bindings (worktree_path, base_ref, base_sha, branch, owner_actor); lock/audit/close/dispatch record the binding as evidence; one canonical binding_health predicate + status model; operator brief and dashboard show active worktrees with branch, dirty status, health reasons, and actor. Enforcement (wrong-worktree refusal + safe cleanup) is split to 2026-06-11-001-feat-worktree-guard-hardening. Out of scope: automatic conflict resolution, multi-machine coordination, agent leases/claims, background rebasing, deleting any worktree (no removal command in this slice), fully parallel orchestration.
completion_test: An operator can run `dontpanic plan worktree create <plan-id>` and get a dedicated worktree on a plan branch at a repo-key-qualified deterministic path from a recorded base SHA (default-branch resolution, never the invoking HEAD implicitly; the base option recorded; registry-write failure rolls back the created worktree and branch); lock/audit/close and dispatch capture the binding snapshot as evidence; `plan worktree list`, the operator brief, and the dashboard UI (DOM-proven) all render the worktree-status model built on the canonical binding_health predicate — branch, dirty, untracked count, actor, per-binding health reasons with explicit nulls, broken bindings, and a visible corrupt-registry warning.

user_journeys.name: isolated-plan-start
user_journeys.description: Operator binds a plan to its own worktree from a recorded base and works there without touching the main tree.

user_journeys.name: fleet-worktree-visibility
user_journeys.description: Operator sees every active worktree (branch, dirty, untracked, actor, broken) in the brief and dashboard.

user_journeys.name: binding-honesty
user_journeys.description: Every binding's true state (healthy/dirty/drifted/broken/corrupt-registry) is visible with reasons across list, brief, and dashboard.

non_goals: A DontPanic merge command (merging to main remains the operator's external gh ritual; the guarded close/disposition path is DontPanic's complete merge-adjacent surface)
